stories.title: The Full Rotation Is Gone — All 5 Cubs Starters Headed to Free Agency
stories.angle: Gausman is a free agent. Boyd's mutual option won't be exercised. Holmes declining his player option. Imanaga free agent. Peterson free agent. All 5 late-season starters gone. Cubs face a full rotation rebuild — which Hoyer has already flagged as Priority No. 1.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
5 of 5 rotation starters are free agents or options expected to be declined.

Gausman. Boyd. Holmes. Imanaga. Peterson.

Jed Hoyer doesn't have a single starter locked in heading into the offseason. The rebuild starts now.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

research.facts:
Full Rotation Is Gone — All 5 Starters Headed to Free Agency
**Key Facts:**
- Kevin Gausman: free agent. Bleacher Report calls him a secondary option for Cubs, expects him to leave.
- Matthew Boyd: $15M MUTUAL option. Neither side expected to pick up.
- Clay Holmes: $12M PLAYER option. Expected to decline.
- Shota Imanaga: free agent.
- David Peterson: free agent.
- All 5 starters confirmed free agents or options expected to be declined — HIGH confidence, multiple sources.

stories.title: Cubs Sold Their Future to the Team That Swept Them
stories.angle: At the 2026 trade deadline, the Cubs shipped Moisés Ballesteros and Jefferson Rojas — two of the Cubs' top prospects — to San Diego. Those Padres just swept the Cubs, outscoring them 12-1 in two WCS games. The irony is brutal and specific.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The Cubs scored 1 run in 2 WCS games against the Padres. 12-1 outscored.

At the trade deadline, Chicago shipped Moisés Ballesteros and Jefferson Rojas — two of the Cubs' top prospects — to San Diego.

Cubs helped build the team that swept them.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

research.facts: Both Ballesteros and Rojas traded to Padres at 2026 deadline — HIGH (multiple sources). Cubs scored 1 total run in WCS — HIGH (box scores). Trade-back not confirmed.

stories.title: PCA Is About to Make Cubs History as First Unanimous NL MVP
stories.angle: PCA is the 7th player in MLB history with a 40-40 season and is on track to win the NL MVP unanimously — a first in Cubs franchise history. Award comes in November.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
45 HR. 41 SB. .280/.372/.570.

Pete Crow-Armstrong is on track to become the first unanimous NL MVP in Cubs franchise history — and the first Cub to ever pull off a 40-40 season.

The season ended too early. The award doesn't.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

research.facts: PCA: .280/.372/.570, 45 HR, 41 SB in 162 games. 7th 40-40 in MLB history. First Cubs player to achieve 40-40. Expected unanimous NL MVP winner (MLB.com final poll). Award mid-November.
